question: Which of the following sites of Harappan civilization is located near Bolan Pass?
solution:
The famous Bolan Pass is situated in **__Mehrgarh__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Mehrgarh is a Neolithic site.
 
• It is located near the Bolan Basin of Balochistan in Pakistan.
 
• It is one of the earliest sites known.
 
• It shows evidence of farming and herding done by man in very early times.
 
• Archaeological evidence suggests that Neolithic culture existed in Mehergarh as early as 7000 BC.
